sql_templates.explanation: Retrieve latest market regime, breadth signal, flow signal, and Nifty 50 close.
sql_templates.template:
SELECT rh.regime, rh.confidence, md.ad_signal, sdf.flow_signal, ie.close 
FROM signals.regime_history rh 
JOIN breadth.market_daily md ON rh.trade_date = md.trade_date 
JOIN signals.fii_dii_flows sdf ON rh.trade_date = sdf.trade_date 
JOIN market.index_eod ie ON rh.trade_date = ie.trade_date 
WHERE ie.index_symbol = 'Nifty 50' 
AND rh.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.index_eod);
